summary: Based on verified civil and regulatory actions against Patagonia, Inc. within the last decade—including an EEOC settlement, a Seattle labor‑standards fine, and an NLRB unfair‑labor‑practice charge—the subject exhibits adverse conduct, supporting an ADVERSE verdict with approximately 82% confidence.

findings.statement: Patagonia, Inc. settled an EEOC complaint in 2019, paying a settlement.
Patagonia, Inc. was fined by the Seattle Office of Labor Standards in 2022 for violating the Secure Scheduling Ordinance, paying a $575.31 fine and agreeing to pay nearly $55,000 to employees.
Patagonia, Inc. faced an NLRB charge of unfair labor practices in 2020, which resulted in no financial fine.

gaps: Exact monetary amount of the 2019 EEOC settlement is not disclosed in the available sources.
